headline: Record dates set for Amara Raja, NALCO, and others
hook: Last chance for upcoming dividend payouts
summary: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility, CARE Ratings, Happiest Minds Technologies, NALCO, and Amrutanjan Health Care have announced record dates for their upcoming dividend payments. Investors must purchase shares before the ex-date to be eligible for these payouts. Buying shares on or after the ex-date will result in the investor not receiving the declared dividend. These corporate actions are part of the regular dividend distribution cycle for these listed entities.
whats_next: Ex-dates for these companies are approaching this week.
why_it_matters: Buy before ex-date to qualify for these dividend payouts.

headline: Last day to buy shares for upcoming dividends
hook: Final call for upcoming dividend payouts
summary: Amara Raja Energy, CARE Ratings, Happiest Minds, NALCO, and Amrutanjan have set record dates for their respective dividend payouts. Investors must purchase these stocks before the ex-date to be eligible for the declared dividends. Holding the shares on the record date ensures the investor is registered in the company's books to receive the payment. This is a routine corporate action for shareholders of these specific companies.
why_it_matters: Buy before ex-date to qualify for dividend payouts.

headline: CARE Ratings appoints Jatindar Pal Singh Bajaj as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director
hook: Leadership change ahead at CARE Ratings
summary: CARE Ratings Limited announced the appointment of Mr. Jatindar Pal Singh Bajaj as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director on its board, effective October 29, 2026. Board shuffles of this nature are standard corporate governance updates for listed entities. Indian retail investors tracking the company's governance and board composition will note this addition.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with negligible immediate impact on stock price

headline: CARE Ratings sets November 6 as dividend record date
hook: Dividend payout date set for CARE Ratings
summary: CARE Ratings Limited has officially declared November 6, 2026, as the record date for its upcoming dividend payment. Shareholders holding the stock as of this date will be eligible to receive the declared dividend. This is a routine corporate action for the company.
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders will receive the dividend payout.
